arguments.text: 6000 m, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Goal: even effort near sustainable shaft power (~150-155 W pod, CP 145 W pod per test, may be 10-25% off), then empty the reserve in the last ~400-500 m. Steps: let the hot start settle by ~2-3 min (ease cue if pod still >170 W at 2.5 min). Check CP via heart rate drift on steady stretches and measure() fits. Watch for drag/weed (push_local drop with no turn), pod drift (pod power vs HR / boat power mismatch), radio course changes. Finish cue at ~400 m to go if reserve allows.
